Constructs the chronological partial branch expansion using actual prepared gate occurrences and retaining untouched exterior aggregate contractions. The original complex coefficients and exact operator and density identities are preserved. Source positions distinguish repeated gate occurrences, with derived endpoint incidence and a branch-independent ordered source layout. The absolute coefficient sum factors over touched occurrences, and independent ket and bra choices square that cost. The corrected-position trace-norm estimate and physical protocol construction remain separate obligations.
